evals.prompt: Render a happy capy with a static thumbs-up using @suigar/suifrens-display-system. Which imports and attributes should I use?
assertions: Imports SuiFrenImage from the package root and CapyAttributes from /types
Uses valid palette keys without a leading #, a skin, an expression and earShape
Uses gesture="thumbs_up" on a full-body character without requiring animation

evals.prompt: Create a standalone SVG with a custom accessory whose assetSrc points to a remote SVG.
assertions: Explains a remote assetSrc remains an external reference even with the inline renderer
Uses a self-contained SVG data URL for the override when offline export is required

evals.prompt: Show how to add a mirrored pink runner kit and a thumbs-down bullshark.
assertions: Uses a six-digit hex color and mirrorBib: true
Uses the shared gesture prop with thumbs_down
